title: Shopify Copilot Tax Matching Agent: matching engine and data model (stack 2/3)
summary: Shopify Copilot Tax Matching Agent adds a headless matching engine that uses AI to match Shopify tax lines to Business Central tax jurisdictions, creates tax areas, and includes comprehensive unit tests.
key_points: Implements tax matching engine with GPT-4.1 capability registration and deterministic provenance tracking
Builds or reuses Tax Areas and seeds Tax Details for matched jurisdictions
Includes configurable review-mode gate to hold Sales Document creation until human verification
Adds comprehensive test app with AITest suites, unit tests, and accuracy datasets for matching logic
Adds table extensions and permission sets to support tax matching workflow in Shopify connector
